by
  let d := Nat.gcd (2 * n + 1) (n + 1)
  have h : d ∣ 2 * n + 1 := Nat.dvd_gcd_left
  have k : d ∣ n + 1 := Nat.dvd_gcd_right
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := k
  have h1 : d ∣ 2 * n + 1 - 2 * (n + 1) := by rw [Nat.dvd_sub]; exact Nat.dvd_mul_right d 2
  have h2 : d ∣ 2 * n + 1 - 2 * (n + 1) := by simp [Nat.sub_self]
  have h3 : d ∣ -1 := by rw [Nat.dvd_sub]; exact Nat.dvd_add_right h1 h2
  have h4 : d ∣ 1 := by rw [Nat.dvd_neg]; exact h3
  exact Nat.dvd_antisymm (Nat.dvd_refl d) h4
